offering_description.value: Veralto sells water testing, monitoring and treatment products to utilities, industrial plants and environmental agencies. It also sells marking and coding equipment, color tools and packaging software to manufacturers, printers and brand owners. It makes equipment and consumables, develops software and provides field services.

primary_products.value: Water testing and monitoring instruments and reagents; water treatment chemicals and UV disinfection systems; industrial marking and coding equipment and supplies; color measurement tools and standards; packaging and supplier compliance software

primary_services.value: Industrial water treatment program management; equipment installation, calibration and maintenance; packaging workflow and color management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Industrial plants, private water utilities, packaged goods manufacturers, brand owners, packaging converters and printers; B2G: Municipal water and wastewater utilities, environmental agencies and public research institutions

end_markets.value: Drinking water and wastewater; industrial water treatment; environmental monitoring; food, beverage and other packaged goods; packaging and commercial printing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Instruments, treatment systems, coding equipment, reagents, chemicals and printing supplies; service fees: Field maintenance, calibration and industrial water treatment services; subscription: Cloud software for packaging workflows and supplier compliance; licensing or royalties: Software licenses and rights to use proprietary color standards
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; subscription; licensing or royalties

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns components and chemical inputs into instruments, treatment products and coding equipment for utilities and manufacturers; service provider: Uses equipment and water quality data to maintain systems and manage treatment programs for utilities and industrial plants; software / platform: Processes artwork, color specifications and supplier data for brands, manufacturers and packaging converters
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia and Latin America

specialization.value: diversified: Water testing, monitoring and treatment alongside product coding, color management, packaging workflows and supplier compliance

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Technical sales teams serving utilities, industrial plants and packaged goods manufacturers; distributors / dealers: Independent distributors of laboratory instruments, water treatment products and industrial coding equipment; online: Company storefronts for reagents, replacement parts and color standards

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Treatment chemical production and sale are subject to chemical safety and environmental rules, including U.S. TSCA and EU REACH.
